  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  1A)          Describe the operation of n-channel enhancement mode MOSFET along with V-I  
  characteristics. Also derive the drain current of MOSFET in terms of VGS, VDS, and the (4)  
  dimension of the device.  
  
  1B)          A silicon diode has reverse saturation current of 15 nA at 25°C. Determine the voltage  
  required to get a forward current of 6 mA at 35°C. Also determine the static and           (3)  
  dynamic resistance of the diode at 40°C.  
  
  1C)          Explain Avalanche breakdown and Zener breakdown mechanisms in diode.  
  (3)  
  
  2A)          An AC voltage of 230V, 50Hz is applied to transformer having turns ratio 10:1. The  
  secondary of the transformer is connected to half wave rectifier. The diode has cut-in  
  voltage 0.6V and forward resistance 8Ω. If the load resistance is 400Ω, determine the      (4)  
  average and rms values of output current and voltage. What should be the PIV rating of  
  the diode.  
  
  2B)          For the Zener diode regulator shown, RS = 10Ω, VZ =10V, Vi = 25V. Find the minimum  
  and maximum current through Zener diode when RL is varied between 10Ω and 100Ω. (3)

  $$µnCox = 200 µA/V2 and VTh = 0.4 V.$$
